column1: !Sample_characteristics_ch1 = cell line: SW480 human colon adenocarcinoma cell line

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Reverse transfections were performed in 6-well plates. Briefly, 60 pmol siRNAs were diluted in 750 μl serum-free media. Subsequently, 1.8 μl Oligofectamine (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA) were mixed with 750 μl serum-free media. These solutions were combined to allow complex formation at ambient temperature. Next, tumor cells were dissolved in 1500 μl serum containing 20% FBS, and added to the reaction (20 nM siRNA). After 45-minute incubation at ambient temperature, plates were kept at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2 atmosphere.
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Cells were grown in RPMI-1640 containing 10% FBS and 1% Penecillin/Streptomycin.

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = After transfection (48h or 72h), total RNA was isolated using TRIzol (Invitrogen, Gaithersburg, MD), and purified using the RNeasy Mini kit (Qiagen, Germantown, MD).  A detailed protocol can be found at www.riedlab.nci.nih.gov/.  Nucleic acid quantity, quality and purity were determined using a spectrophotometer (Nanodrop, Rockland, DE) and a 2100 Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies, Palo Alto, CA).  Only RNA samples with a RNA integrity number between 9.0 and 10.0 were considered for further analysis.

!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = 600 ng of total RNA were reverse-transcribed and amplified, thereby incorporating Cyanine 3-CTP nucleotides, using the Low RNA Input Fluorescent Linear Amplification Kit according to the manufacturer's recommendations (Agilent One-Color Microarray-Based Gene Expression Analysis, protocol version 5.5, February 2007; Agilent Technologies).

!Sample_hyb_protocol = After a two-hour reaction, 1.5 μg of purified, Cy3-labeled cRNA were hybridized to an oligonucleotide Whole Human Genome Microarray (4x44K, Agilent Technologies) for 17 hours at 65˚C, then washed according to manufacturer's protocol.
!Sample_scan_protocol = Slides were scanned using an Agilent G2565BA scanner, and data were extracted using the Feature Extraction software version 9.5.1 (Agilent Technologies).
!Sample_data_processing = Median signal intensities from the Feature Extraction Software were converted to log2 and quantile normalized using the R package “limma”.
